notes: Answer questions from the phone: the host question bridge accepts option answers per row, emits question.resolved, and returns the full answers batch to the agent when every question in the call is answered. Desktop remains a competing answerer and the first whole answer wins; questions.mobileAnswer:false restores read-only. Lost-race errors hide only the raced question and show 'Already answered on the desktop'. Fake-host question-answer mode (8 checks) is now in CI; free-text questions still require the desktop.
